svg.title: First retained runtime campaign: failed targets
svg.desc: All 16 observation states reconstruct. Under pinned tiktoken 0.12.0/o200k_base, the raw SDK result decreases 52.27%, CLI JSON 41.62%, MCP 43.35%. The SDK full result duplicates human text and snapshot; its passing percentage does not establish the other transports or end-to-end model savings. These misses motivated lossless baseline-relative metadata inheritance.
